hypothesis_text: GCN2/EIF2AK4 activity is associated with the magnitude of the CD8+ T-cell response following YF-17D vaccination.

scientific_criteria.description: EIF2AK4 expression or a defensible GCN2 proxy can be measured.
A quantitative CD8+ T-cell response is measured.
Predictor precedes or is contemporaneous with an appropriate post-vaccination outcome.
Predictor and outcome can be linked within participants.

operational_criteria.description: Predictor data can currently be retrieved.
Outcome data can currently be retrieved.
